description: The in-game world frame. maps_without_particles: maps whose frame skips the shared particle update (their own effects drive it). health_rumble: the pad rumble strength while hurt, indexed by health rounded up to tenths; above the end of the list the rumble is left alone. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.
